key.name: show-recents
key.description: When off, the strip only appears when the pointer touches the screen edge.

key.name: group-mode
key.description: "one-at-a-time": each new window gets its own stage. "all-at-once": windows of the same app go together.

key.name: group-layout
key.description: "mosaic": the group rearranges when a window joins or leaves, is resized, or is dropped onto another. "free": only arranges when the composition changes; the rest is free, like macOS.

key.name: autotile
key.description: On: windows on the stage fill the screen in a tree layout (like Pop Shell autotiling), leaving the app strip on the left. Resizing moves the divider; dropping a window onto another swaps them.

key.name: autotile-margin
key.description: Distance between windows and the edge of the usable area (and the strip, when shown).

key.name: autotile-strip-always
key.description: On: with an autotiled group the app strip stays visible and windows leave room for it. Off: the strip hides (it appears when the pointer touches the edge) and windows use the whole screen.

key.name: pip-enabled
key.description: PiP joins the stage group where it appears and only its width takes part in tiling; the height follows the video aspect ratio.

key.name: pip-patterns
key.description: Regular expressions, case-insensitive. Firefox uses "Picture-in-Picture" and Chrome "Picture in picture".

key.name: pip-max-width
key.summary: Maximum PiP width (% of the area)

key.name: show-add-button
key.description: The + button that appears over a thumbnail in the strip when you hover it adds that set to the stage group. Shift+click and dragging do the same.

key.name: max-recents
key.summary: Maximum items in the strip (0 = as many as fit)

key.name: always-center
key.summary: Center the window when entering the stage

key.name: lock-center
key.description: Outside autotiling, the window (or group) returns to the center as soon as you drop it after dragging, finish resizing it, or the app changes its size/position.

key.name: center-resize
key.description: When dragging a window edge or corner with the mouse, the window grows or shrinks on both sides at once, keeping its center (like the Option key on macOS). “alt” does it only while Alt is held; “always” does it by default and Alt gives the regular resize. Not used with autotiling.

key.name: remember-position
key.summary: Remember the position of windows moved by hand
key.description: On: a window you dragged stays where you left it, also when switching away and back. Off: always centers when entering the stage.

key.name: click-wallpaper
key.summary: Clicking the wallpaper shows the desktop

key.name: excluded-classes
key.description: Windows of these classes (WM_CLASS / app-id) stay loose: they do not join the stage or the strip and do not change the stage when opened. Default: GNOME Sushi (Nautilus previewer).

key.name: pick-request
key.summary: Request (from preferences) to pick a window to ignore
key.description: Internal use: the preferences window sets this and the extension opens the window picker.

key.name: toggle-exception
key.summary: Ignore / manage again the focused window's app

key.name: pick-exception
key.summary: Pick a window to ignore with the mouse

key.name: switch-recent
key.summary: Switch to the most recent set in the strip

key.name: add-to-stage
key.summary: Add the most recent set in the strip to the stage

key.name: remove-from-stage
key.summary: Remove the focused window from its set (sends it to the strip)

key.name: arrange-group
key.summary: Rearrange the stage group as a mosaic
